config.notes: Two page kinds. study.unimelb.edu.au/find/courses/<level>/<course>/ course pages are read in the INTERNATIONAL student view (page_view: Firecrawl render of the address with ?residency=international, tested 5 Oct: ?studentType= and ?student= leave the domestic view). The international header strip gives Duration, Mode (Location), Intake months (before "Key dates"), "Fees AUD $NN,NNN (YYYY indicative first year fee)" and "English language requirements IELTS N.N: with no band less than N.N". The fee and IELTS patterns require the English-requirements block that only the international view prints, so a domestic full-fee figure is never read. handbook.unimelb.edu.au/<year>/courses pages (not in the view): Overview table with Year & campus, CRICOS code, Study level & type, AQF level, Duration, Delivered mode, and a not-available-to-international-students notice; no intakes, fees or IELTS. Courses bound to the handbook were rebound to their own study.unimelb page where that page appears in stored links (5 Oct). 5 Oct 15:22 checks: exit awards - no 'N years of full-time study ... exit with' wording on stored pages; handbook pages of two Graduate Certificates say they are exit awards (credit points), one set by hand (Grad Cert in Science (Advanced) from the Graduate Diploma in Science (Advanced), 50 cp = 6 months full-time). No whole-course fees (the international header prints an indicative first-year fee). Entry requirements are not printed on the stored pages (study pages link to a separate entry-requirements page; handbook pages to 'Entry and participation requirements'), so no entry_requirement pattern.
